title: ASK UNK — Spatial Card Gallery
summary: A portable interaction study for moving between a dense collection and a spatial, focus-driven view without losing context.

blocks.content:
Sports-card collections become difficult to navigate when every item competes for the same amount of space. This experiment explores a continuous transition between a compact six-row gallery and a free-moving spatial field.

The same cards remain visible throughout the transition, preserving orientation while allowing one card to become the focus.
The interaction should feel like moving through one collection—not switching between two unrelated screens.

- Drag to pan through the collection.
- Pinch out to enter the spatial view.
- Pinch in to return to the compact grid.
- Tap a card to bring it into focus.
- Use arrow keys, plus, minus, and zero for keyboard navigation.
